description.value:
Sokan turns the battlefield itself into a weapon, pairing deliberate, grounded movement with sudden decisive strikes to keep an opponent's footing unstable. Its practitioners read terrain the way other guardians read a blade, herding enemies toward ledges, hazards, and choke points before finishing them off.

Persistence defines the style: a Sokan duelist plants themselves, resists being shoved or moved, and steadily maneuvers the fight onto ground of their own choosing.
